title: Korean literati purges
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Korean literati purges", at revision 1376813248, opens: "Literati purges is a translation of the Korean term sahwa, which literally translates to "scholars' calamity." It refers to a series of political purges in the late 15th and 16th centuries in which Sarim scholars suffered persecution at the hands of their political rivals." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q196688, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of political purges in the late 15th and 16th centuries". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
